title: Adopt schematify:// URI scheme for all internal references
context: Prior applications used `forger://`, `journeyman://`, and `decision://` schemes. Each application had its own scheme, and cross-references required knowing which application held the object.
decision: Retire `forger://`, `journeyman://`, and `decision://` schemes. Adopt `schematify://node/<uuid>`, `schematify://screen/<uuid>`, `schematify://flow/<uuid>`, and `schematify://decision/<uuid>` for all internal references. All stored references use the `schematify://` form.
consequences: Single, unified scheme across all Schematify object kinds; wave 1 must convert every stored reference; no ambiguity about which application holds an object; URI resolution stays within Schematify.
